issuer: the Department of Transportation and Public Works (DTOP), through its Driver's Services Centres (CESCO)

licence.name: Licencia de Conducir (certificado de licencia para conducir vehículos de motor)

note: Read 2026-10-30: the DTOP's CESCO application forms, linked from cesco.pr.gov's 'Solicitudes y formularios'. Form DTOP-DIS-258 (application for a driver's licence certificate by change of category, rev. 17 February 2025) notes that driver's licence certificates are issued to people 18 and older, the age held. The forms read give the learner's certificate's stamps ($11 and others, a two-year term) but no fee or term for the driver's licence itself, so both are null. Form DTOP-DIS-137 (identification card for people 16 or older, rev. 19 February 2026): the applicant must be 16 or older, and a first card ('Expedición tarjeta por primera vez') takes an internal revenue voucher of $20 (code 2028), the fee held; the card's term isn't stated (null). The $2 trauma-centre charge, the anatomical-donation stamp and the Real ID versions aren't held. No exchange (reciprocity) list was read.
